items.title: EIP-8272：规定 RECENT_ROOT_CODE
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。PR 说明：`RECENT_ROOT_CODE` 目前是 TBD，recent root 合约的行为已完整规定却没有实现它的代码；今天安装预部署的客户端只会得到空账户，每次写入只是普通转账、什么也不承诺，之后每次引用都会校验失败。PR 直接按规范组装代码填入常量。
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. Per the PR, `RECENT_ROOT_CODE` is currently TBD, so the recent root contract has fully specified behavior and no code implementing it; a client installing the predeploy today installs an empty account, every write is a plain value transfer that commits nothing, and every later reference fails its check. The PR assembles the code directly from the spec and fills in the constant.

items.title: ethresear.ch：x402 代理支付的原子零知识证明门控结算
items.note: 01:47。作者指出 x402 让代理为资源调用付款，却不把付款和执行正确性绑定；其参考设计 ZkInferenceEscrow 让 AI 推理调用的付款在一笔交易内结算，前提是链上零知识证明验证该调用由指定的固定电路执行。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: atomic ZK-proof-gated settlement for x402 agent payments
items.note_en: 01:47. The author notes that x402 lets an agent pay for a resource call but never binds payment to correct execution; the ZkInferenceEscrow reference design settles payment for an AI inference call in one transaction, only when an onchain zero-knowledge proof verifies the call ran on a specific pinned circuit.

summary_en: A quiet Saturday. PRs that open the abstracts of EIP-8250 (keyed nonces) and EIP-8272 (recent roots) with their privacy benefit were merged, and another PR fills in code for EIP-8272's recent root contract so the path can be tested end to end. On ethresear someone posted a reference design for zero-knowledge-proof-gated settlement of x402 agent payments, and AndyGuzman argued that infrastructure such as RPCs, indexers and bundlers needs privacy to avoid regulatory pressure.
